dataRoles.name: controlSet
dataRoles.description: Optional. Identifies whether each row belongs to the Initial or Additional control set. Omit it to render a single bowtie from the available rows.

dataRoles.name: causeId
dataRoles.description: Required for causal-factor rows. Unique identifier for the cause shown on the left side of the bowtie.

dataRoles.name: causeName
dataRoles.description: Optional. Label shown for the cause node.

dataRoles.name: causeTooltip
dataRoles.description: Optional. Extra information displayed in the cause tooltip.

dataRoles.name: preventiveControlId
dataRoles.description: Required for preventive-control rows. Links the cause, preventive control, risk, and hazard together.

dataRoles.name: preventiveControlName
dataRoles.description: Optional. Label shown for the preventive-control node.

dataRoles.name: preventiveControlTooltip
dataRoles.description: Optional. Extra information displayed in the preventive-control tooltip.

dataRoles.name: preventiveControlHierarchy
dataRoles.description: Optional. Hierarchy-of-controls category used to group or label the preventive control.

dataRoles.name: preventiveVerificationMethod
dataRoles.description: Optional. One or more verification methods linked to the preventive control.

dataRoles.name: preventiveVerificationPhase
dataRoles.description: Optional. One or more verification phases linked to the preventive control.

dataRoles.name: preventiveBeforeSeverity
dataRoles.description: Optional. Severity for the before-risk node associated with the preventive control.

dataRoles.name: preventiveBeforeProbability
dataRoles.description: Optional. Probability for the before-risk node associated with the preventive control.

dataRoles.name: preventiveBeforeRisk
dataRoles.description: Optional. MIL-STD-882E risk level for the before-risk node. Used when severity and probability are not supplied.

dataRoles.name: preventiveAfterSeverity
dataRoles.description: Optional. Severity for the after-risk node associated with the preventive control.

dataRoles.name: preventiveAfterProbability
dataRoles.description: Optional. Probability for the after-risk node associated with the preventive control.

dataRoles.name: preventiveAfterRisk
dataRoles.description: Optional. MIL-STD-882E risk level for the after-risk node. Used when severity and probability are not supplied.

dataRoles.name: hazardId
dataRoles.description: Required. Identifies the top-event hazard. Filter to one hazard for the visual to render.

dataRoles.name: hazardName
dataRoles.description: Optional. Label shown for the hazard node.

dataRoles.name: hazardTooltip
dataRoles.description: Optional. Extra information displayed in the hazard tooltip.

dataRoles.name: mitigatingControlId
dataRoles.description: Required for mitigating-control rows. Links the hazard, mitigating control, risk, and effect together.

dataRoles.name: mitigatingControlName
dataRoles.description: Optional. Label shown for the mitigating-control node.

dataRoles.name: mitigatingControlTooltip
dataRoles.description: Optional. Extra information displayed in the mitigating-control tooltip.

dataRoles.name: mitigatingControlHierarchy
dataRoles.description: Optional. Hierarchy-of-controls category used to group or label the mitigating control.

dataRoles.name: mitigatingVerificationMethod
dataRoles.description: Optional. One or more verification methods linked to the mitigating control.

dataRoles.name: mitigatingVerificationPhase
dataRoles.description: Optional. One or more verification phases linked to the mitigating control.

dataRoles.name: mitigatingBeforeSeverity
dataRoles.description: Optional. Severity for the before-risk node associated with the mitigating control.

dataRoles.name: mitigatingBeforeProbability
dataRoles.description: Optional. Probability for the before-risk node associated with the mitigating control.

dataRoles.name: mitigatingBeforeRisk
dataRoles.description: Optional. MIL-STD-882E risk level for the before-risk node. Used when severity and probability are not supplied.

dataRoles.name: mitigatingAfterSeverity
dataRoles.description: Optional. Severity for the after-risk node associated with the mitigating control.

dataRoles.name: mitigatingAfterProbability
dataRoles.description: Optional. Probability for the after-risk node associated with the mitigating control.

dataRoles.name: mitigatingAfterRisk
dataRoles.description: Optional. MIL-STD-882E risk level for the after-risk node. Used when severity and probability are not supplied.

dataRoles.name: effectId
dataRoles.description: Required for effect rows. Unique identifier for the outcome on the right side of the bowtie.

dataRoles.name: effectName
dataRoles.description: Optional. Label shown for the effect node.

dataRoles.name: effectTooltip
dataRoles.description: Optional. Extra information displayed in the effect tooltip.

dataRoles.name: highlightMeasure
dataRoles.description: Optional. Measure used to cross-highlight this visual from other visuals or slicers.
